name: l5-entry
description: Drive the original to LEVEL 5 entry (the boundary-metal-brick level where known-bugs #6 lived) for oracle frame-stepping beyond L3. Mechanism (per capture_levels_modded.py): poke the level counter $B7EA to the level index (L5 = 4) and set PC=$BA24 (= CALL briks_calc -> full level-init: loads level 5's bricks into current_level_copy and paints), then run to the main-loop entry $BA83. The $BA6C metal-brick shimmer call is NOPed to match the static level-entry render, and the RNG is pinned, exactly like l3-brick-flash.
